sentence: This project develops a measure of resilience and susceptibility to psychopathology tied to social determinants of health, then studies its genomic and neural correlates.
This project studies how two enzyme subunits of a chromatin remodeling complex control gene expression and behavioral responses to ethanol in mice.
This project studies how the fetal immune system responds to viral infection and inflammation, and how immune signaling affects stress responses in the fetal brain.
This project uses a technique called Electron Spin Resonance to study how virus parts attack cells and how a protein called complexin interacts with membranes.
This project studies whether regulatory T cells in the lung can suppress allergic inflammation by sitting alongside memory T cells that drive allergic asthma.
This project develops image processing and analysis methods to detect glaucoma and predict how it progresses, using optical coherence tomography and machine learning.
This project studies how methionine restriction affects cancer and the epigenome in aging animals and in breast cancer models.
This project tests whether a non-canonical form of ferroptosis helps suppress tumor growth in breast and liver cancers.
This project grows stem cells into atrial-like heart muscle cells and engineered heart tissue to study atrial fibrillation.
This project studies how a histone methyltransferase complex drives small cell lung cancer transformation and tests whether inhibitors of it can block that transformation.
This project studies how androgens and estrogens regulate genes and brain mechanisms in a social cichlid fish.
This project develops imaging agents and methods, including ultrasound and photoacoustic imaging, to detect, diagnose and treat cancer.
This project supports a research platform designed to find individual variations that matter for medical care.
This project studies how social factors and the immune system are involved when acute low back pain becomes chronic low back pain.
This project looks for environmental, lifestyle, genetic and socio-structural targets to prevent cancer and improve its detection.
This project uses spatial transcriptomics, computational modeling and electrophysiology to study how intracortical microstimulation affects different types of brain cells.
This project builds a deep learning microscope to quickly examine tumor margins in fresh tissue removed during oral cancer surgery.
This project builds sequencing methods and computational tools to find somatic mosaicism, which is genetic variation within human tissues.
This project studies how circuits in the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex support spatial learning, decision-making and generalization in monkeys navigating virtually.
This project studies molecules made during septic injury that contribute to multiple organ dysfunction.
